summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching an Appendix 2A application to the ASX for quotation of 34,824 ordinary shares. The shares were issued upon the vesting of performance rights under an employee incentive scheme, with no cash consideration. This is a routine corporate action unrelated to a special situation. The filing is a foreign private issuer report of a standard securities quotation, not an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or a forced management change.
